<style>
#dist-root{
  width:min(1400px,100%);
  margin:0 auto
}
.dist-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:end;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:9px
}
.dist-head h2{
  margin-bottom:2px
}
.dist-head>div{
  max-width:820px
}
.dist-stats{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:7px;
  margin-bottom:10px
}
.dist-stat{
  padding:9px 10px;
  border:1px solid #cedfe3;
  border-radius:9px;
  background:#f8fbfc
}
.dist-stat strong{
  display:block;
  color:#0b7180;
  font-size:18px
}
.dist-stat span{
  color:#5f7680;
  font-size:9px
}
.dist-workload{
  margin-bottom:11px;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid #cfdee2;
  border-radius:10px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.91)
}
.dist-workload h3,
.dist-section-head h3{
  margin:0 0 6px;
  color:#173f51;
  font-size:12px
}
.dist-workload-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:5px
}
.dist-user{
  padding:7px 8px;
  border:1px solid #d7e5e8;
  border-radius:7px;
  background:#f7fbfc
}
.dist-user strong{
  display:block;
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#315562;
  font-size:9.5px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.dist-user small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#748890;
  font-size:8px
}
.dist-section{
  margin-top:8px
}
.dist-section-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px
}
.dist-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:7px
}
.dist-task-card{
  padding:10px 11px;
  border:1px solid #cadde1;
  border-radius:10px;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(15,48,70,.04)
}
.dist-task-card.unassigned{
  border-left:4px solid #b96b36
}
.dist-task-card.assigned{
  border-left:4px solid #0b7e89
}
.dist-task-top{
  display:flex;
  align-items:start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:8px;
  margin-bottom:7px
}
.dist-task-top strong{
  display:block;
  color:#173e50;
  font-size:10.5px
}
.dist-task-top small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#758990;
  font-size:8.3px
}
.dist-task-status{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  padding:4px 6px;
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#7c4d28;
  background:#fff0e4;
  font-size:7.8px;
  font-weight:750
}
.assigned .dist-task-status{
  color:#08636d;
  background:#e6f4f5
}
.dist-task-info{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:5px;
  margin-bottom:7px
}
.dist-task-info>div{
  min-width:0;
  padding:6px 7px;
  border-radius:6px;
  background:#f7fafb
}
.dist-task-info span{
  display:block;
  color:#778b93;
  font-size:7.8px
}
.dist-task-info strong{
  display:block;
  overflow:hidden;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#385a67;
  font-size:8.8px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.dist-assign-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  gap:6px;
  align-items:end
}
.dist-assign-row .field{
  margin:0
}
.dist-empty{
  grid-column:1/-1;
  padding:20px;
  border:1px dashed #bfd3d8;
  border-radius:9px;
  color:#6f838b;
  text-align:center;
  background:#f9fbfc
}
.dist-completed{
  margin-top:10px
}
.dist-done-grid{
  display:grid;
  gap:3px;
  margin-top:6px
}
.dist-done-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.3fr .7fr 1fr;
  gap:8px;
  padding:6px 7px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #e3ebed;
  color:#657a83;
  font-size:8.7px
}
.dist-done-row strong{
  color:#365764
}
@media(max-width:1000px){
  .dist-stats,
  .dist-workload-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
  .dist-grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}
@media(max-width:650px){
  .dist-head{
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .dist-stats,
  .dist-workload-grid,
  .dist-task-info,
  .dist-assign-row,
  .dist-done-row{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}


/* Tarefas internas — criação, acompanhamento, anexos e diálogo */
.dist-head-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.dist-general-section{margin-top:12px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid #dbe7ea}
.dist-general-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}
.dist-general-card{padding:11px;border:1px solid #cbdde2;border-left:4px solid #0b7e89;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(15,48,70,.04)}
.dist-general-card.done{opacity:.76;border-left-color:#8a9ba1;background:#f7fafb}
.dist-general-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.dist-general-top strong{color:#173e50;font-size:10.8px;line-height:1.25}
.dist-general-status{flex:0 0 auto;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;color:#08636d;background:#e6f4f5;font-size:7.7px;font-weight:800}
.dist-general-status.done{color:#526a74;background:#edf2f4}
.dist-general-description{margin:6px 0;color:#5e7580;font-size:9px;line-height:1.4;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.dist-general-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;margin:7px 0}
.dist-general-meta>div{min-width:0;padding:6px 7px;border-radius:6px;background:#f7fafb}
.dist-general-meta span{display:block;color:#778b93;font-size:7.7px}
.dist-general-meta strong{display:block;overflow:hidden;margin-top:2px;color:#385a67;font-size:8.7px;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.dist-priority{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:999px;font-size:7.4px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase}
.dist-priority.baixa{color:#526b75;background:#edf3f5}
.dist-priority.normal{color:#0b6874;background:#e7f4f5}
.dist-priority.alta{color:#8a5928;background:#fff1df}
.dist-priority.urgente{color:#9c342f;background:#fde8e6}
.dist-create-dialog,.dist-general-dialog{width:min(900px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:90vh;padding:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #b9d3d9;border-radius:14px;color:#173f51;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(6,35,48,.28)}
.dist-create-dialog::backdrop,.dist-general-dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(8,31,44,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
.dist-create-shell,.dist-general-dialog-shell{display:flex;max-height:90vh;flex-direction:column}
.dist-create-head,.dist-general-dialog-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px 12px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b6674,#0b8490)}
.dist-create-head h3,.dist-general-dialog-head h3{margin:0;color:#fff;font-size:15px}
.dist-create-head p,.dist-general-dialog-head p{margin:3px 0 0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.84);font-size:9px}
.dist-create-head button,.dist-general-dialog-head button{min-height:28px;padding:4px 8px;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25);background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.dist-create-body,.dist-general-dialog-body{overflow:auto;padding:13px 15px 15px}
.dist-create-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}
.dist-create-grid .wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.dist-create-body textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
.dist-create-body input[type=file]{width:100%;padding:8px;border:1px dashed #b9d4da;border-radius:8px;background:#f8fbfc}
.dist-create-actions,.dist-general-dialog-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;margin-top:11px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid #dbe6e9}
.dist-general-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.dist-general-overview>div{padding:8px;border:1px solid #d4e3e6;border-radius:7px;background:#f8fbfc}
.dist-general-overview span{display:block;color:#73878f;font-size:8px}
.dist-general-overview strong{display:block;margin-top:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#315563;font-size:9.4px}
.dist-general-text{margin:9px 0;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d9e5e8;border-radius:8px;background:#fbfdfd;color:#3e5e69;font-size:9.4px;line-height:1.5;white-space:pre-wrap}
.dist-general-panel{margin-top:10px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid #e0e9eb}
.dist-general-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.dist-general-panel-head h4{margin:0;font-size:11px}
.dist-general-panel-head input[type=file]{display:none}
.dist-general-files{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}
.dist-general-file{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 8px;border:1px solid #d5e3e7;border-radius:7px;background:#fbfdfd}
.dist-general-file strong{display:block;overflow:hidden;color:#315461;font-size:9px;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.dist-general-file small{display:block;margin-top:1px;color:#7b8e95;font-size:7.8px}
.dist-chat{display:flex;max-height:260px;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;overflow:auto;padding:5px 1px}
.dist-chat-message{padding:8px 9px;border:1px solid #d7e4e7;border-radius:9px;background:#f8fbfc}
.dist-chat-message.mine{border-color:#bcdde0;background:#eef8f8}
.dist-chat-message-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:3px}
.dist-chat-message-head strong{color:#315461;font-size:8.6px}
.dist-chat-message-head span{color:#819198;font-size:7.5px}
.dist-chat-message p{margin:0;color:#45636e;font-size:9px;line-height:1.45;white-space:pre-wrap}
.dist-chat-empty{padding:12px;border:1px dashed #c9dadd;border-radius:8px;color:#758991;text-align:center;font-size:8.7px}
.dist-chat-compose{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:6px;align-items:end;margin-top:7px}
.dist-chat-compose textarea{min-height:62px;resize:vertical}
@media(max-width:1000px){.dist-general-meta,.dist-general-overview{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.dist-general-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:650px){.dist-head-actions,.dist-create-actions,.dist-general-dialog-actions{flex-direction:column}.dist-head-actions button,.dist-create-actions button,.dist-general-dialog-actions button{width:100%}.dist-create-grid,.dist-general-meta,.dist-general-overview,.dist-general-files,.dist-chat-compose{grid-template-columns:1fr}.dist-create-grid .wide{grid-column:auto}.dist-create-dialog,.dist-general-dialog{width:calc(100vw - 16px)}}



/* Distribuição V2 */
.dist-tabs{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:6px;
  justify-content:flex-end
}
.dist-tabs button{
  min-height:34px!important;
  padding:6px 11px!important
}
.dist-actionbar{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  align-items:center;
  gap:7px;
  margin:10px 0;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--pda-line);
  border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.96);
  box-shadow:var(--pda-shadow-soft)
}
.dist-auto-state{
  margin-right:auto;
  padding:5px 8px;
  border-radius:999px;
  font-size:8px;
  font-weight:800
}
.dist-auto-state.is-on{
  color:#246a50;
  background:#e6f5ed
}
.dist-auto-state.is-off{
  color:#7f5a30;
  background:#fff1dc
}
.dist-filterbar{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(230px,1.5fr) repeat(2,minmax(150px,.8fr)) repeat(4,minmax(135px,.72fr));
  gap:7px;
  margin:10px 0 16px;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--pda-line);
  border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,253,249,.96)
}
.dist-filterbar .field{
  margin:0!important
}
.dist-filterbar .field>span{
  font-size:7.7px!important
}
.dist-filterbar input,
.dist-filterbar select{
  min-height:36px!important;
  font-size:9px!important
}
.dist-ranking-filters{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  align-items:end;
  gap:8px;
  margin:12px 0;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--pda-line);
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.dist-ranking-filters .field{
  min-width:170px;
  margin:0!important
}
.dist-ranking-table{
  border-radius:12px!important;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.dist-ranking-table th:first-child,
.dist-ranking-table td:first-child{
  width:42px;
  text-align:center
}
.dist-ranking-table tbody tr:nth-child(1){
  background:#fff6df
}
.dist-ranking-table tbody tr:nth-child(2){
  background:#f4f8f6
}
.dist-ranking-table tbody tr:nth-child(3){
  background:#f8f3ed
}
.dist-history-grid{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(330px,1fr))!important
}
.dist-history-card{
  display:grid;
  gap:10px;
  padding:12px;
  border:1px solid #d9d7cf;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.dist-create-body select[multiple]{
  min-height:94px!important
}
@media(max-width:1250px){
  .dist-filterbar{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
}
@media(max-width:780px){
  .dist-head{
    align-items:flex-start!important;
    flex-direction:column!important
  }
  .dist-tabs{
    justify-content:flex-start
  }
  .dist-filterbar{
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr
  }
}
@media(max-width:520px){
  .dist-filterbar{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}

.dist-task-tags{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:5px;
  margin:6px 0
}
.dist-task-tag{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:21px;
  padding:3px 7px;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-tag-color,#176e7d) 45%,white);
  border-radius:999px;
  color:var(--task-tag-color,#176e7d);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-tag-color,#176e7d) 10%,white);
  font-size:7.5px;
  font-weight:800
}
.dist-general-card .actions button:not(.secondary){
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      var(--task-accent,var(--pda-sea)),
      color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-accent,var(--pda-sea)) 78%,#07364b)
    )!important
}

.dist-task-card.due-96{
  border-color:#e5b96d!important;
  box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 #d49a42,var(--pda-shadow-soft)!important
}
.dist-task-card.due-24{
  border-color:#e19069!important;
  box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 #dc704d,var(--pda-shadow-soft)!important
}
.dist-task-card.overdue{
  border-color:#d77e76!important;
  box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 #c65349,var(--pda-shadow-soft)!important;
  background:#fff9f7!important
}


/* Ranking operacional e cores funcionais das tags */
.dist-ranking-panels{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px;
  margin:10px 0 14px
}
.dist-rank-board{
  min-width:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid #d9ddd8;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#fffdfa;
  box-shadow:var(--pda-shadow-soft)
}
.dist-rank-board h3{
  margin:0!important;
  padding:10px 11px!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid #e3e0d8;
  color:#244b57!important;
  background:#f3f7f5;
  font-size:9px!important
}
.dist-rank-line{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  gap:8px;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:44px;
  padding:7px 9px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #eee9df
}
.dist-rank-line:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.dist-rank-line>div{
  display:grid;
  min-width:0
}
.dist-rank-line b{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#2c4d58;
  font-size:8.5px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.dist-rank-line small{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#7a8783;
  font-size:7px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.dist-rank-line>span:last-child{
  color:var(--pda-sea);
  font-family:var(--pda-display);
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:650
}
.dist-rank-position{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  width:24px;
  height:24px;
  border-radius:50%;
  color:#fff;
  background:#6f8790;
  font-size:8px
}
.dist-rank-line:nth-of-type(2) .dist-rank-position{background:#d49a42}
.dist-rank-line:nth-of-type(3) .dist-rank-position{background:#82979d}
.dist-rank-line:nth-of-type(4) .dist-rank-position{background:#b98265}

.dist-task-card,
.dist-general-card{
  --task-accent:var(--pda-sea)
}
.dist-task-card{
  box-shadow:
    inset 3px 0 0 var(--task-accent),
    var(--pda-shadow-soft)!important
}
.dist-task-card .dist-assign-row button:not(.secondary),
.dist-general-card .actions button:not(.secondary){
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      var(--task-accent),
      color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-accent) 76%,#07364b)
    )!important
}

@media(max-width:1180px){
  .dist-ranking-panels{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .dist-ranking-panels{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}


/* =========================================================
   DISTRIBUIÇÃO — FILA OPERACIONAL COMPACTA
   ========================================================= */
.dist-grid,
.dist-general-grid{
  grid-template-columns:1fr!important;
  gap:5px!important
}
.dist-task-card{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(190px,1fr) minmax(360px,2fr) minmax(330px,1.55fr) auto;
  grid-template-areas:
    "top info assign actions"
    "tags info assign actions";
  gap:4px 10px!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  min-height:82px!important;
  padding:8px 10px!important;
  border-radius:9px!important
}
.dist-task-top{
  grid-area:top;
  align-items:center!important;
  margin:0!important
}
.dist-task-top strong{
  font-size:9.5px!important
}
.dist-task-top small{
  margin-top:1px!important;
  font-size:7px!important
}
.dist-task-status{
  padding:3px 5px!important;
  font-size:6.4px!important
}
.dist-task-info{
  grid-area:info;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:3px 6px!important;
  margin:0!important
}
.dist-task-info>div{
  padding:2px 3px!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  background:transparent!important
}
.dist-task-info span{
  font-size:6.4px!important
}
.dist-task-info strong{
  margin-top:0!important;
  font-size:7.6px!important
}
.dist-task-tags{
  grid-area:tags;
  align-self:center!important;
  margin:0!important;
  gap:3px!important
}
.dist-task-tag{
  min-height:18px!important;
  padding:2px 5px!important;
  font-size:6.3px!important
}
.dist-assign-row{
  grid-area:assign;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto!important;
  gap:5px!important;
  align-items:end!important
}
.dist-assign-row .field>span{
  font-size:6.5px!important
}
.dist-assign-row select{
  min-height:29px!important;
  padding:4px 6px!important;
  font-size:7.5px!important
}
.dist-assign-row button{
  min-height:29px!important;
  padding:5px 7px!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
  font-size:7px!important
}
.dist-card-quick-actions{
  grid-area:actions;
  display:flex!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  margin:0!important;
  padding:0!important
}
.dist-card-quick-actions button{
  min-height:28px!important;
  padding:5px 7px!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
  font-size:7px!important
}

.dist-general-card{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(250px,1.25fr) minmax(390px,1.8fr) minmax(90px,.55fr) auto;
  grid-template-areas:"gtop gmeta gtags gactions";
  gap:8px 11px!important;
  align-items:center!important;

<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.DIST = (()=>{
  const {
    el,button,call,alive,status
  }=App;

  const MAX_FILE_BYTES=5*1024*1024;

  function money_(value){
    return Number(value||0).toLocaleString(
      'pt-BR',
      {style:'currency',currency:'BRL'}
    );
  }

  function cpf_(value){
    const d=String(value||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
    return d.length===11
      ?d.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{2})/,'$1.$2.$3-$4')
      :String(value||'');
  }

  function date_(value){
    const text=String(value||'').trim();
    if(!text)return '—';
    const m=text.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
    return m
      ?m[3]+'/'+m[2]+'/'+m[1]
      :text;
  }

  function dateTime_(value){
    const text=String(value||'').trim();
    if(!text)return '';
    const d=new Date(text);
    if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return text;
    return d.toLocaleString('pt-BR');
  }

  function priority_(value){
    return ({
      BAIXA:'Baixa',
      NORMAL:'Normal',
      ALTA:'Alta',
      URGENTE:'Urgente'
    })[String(value||'NORMAL').toUpperCase()]||'Normal';
  }

  function bytes_(value){
    const n=Number(value||0);
    if(!n)return '';
    if(n<1024)return n+' B';
    if(n<1024*1024)return (n/1024).toFixed(1)+' KB';
    return (n/(1024*1024)).toFixed(1)+' MB';
  }

  function field_(label,control){
    const field=el('label',undefined,'field');
    field.append(el('span',label),control);
    return field;
  }

  function validatePdfFiles_(files){
    const list=Array.from(files||[]);

    list.forEach(file=>{
      const name=String(file&&file.name||'');
      const mime=String(file&&file.type||'').toLowerCase();

      if(
        !file||
        !/\.pdf$/i.test(name)||
        (
          mime&&
          mime!=='application/pdf'
        )
      ){
        throw new Error(
          'Somente arquivos PDF podem ser anexados.'
        );
      }

      if(file.size>MAX_FILE_BYTES){
        throw new Error(
          'Cada PDF deve ter no máximo 5 MB: '+name
        );
      }
    });

    return list;
  }

  function fileBase64_(file){
    return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
      try{
        validatePdfFiles_([file]);
      }catch(e){
        reject(e);
        return;
      }

      const reader=new FileReader();

      reader.onerror=()=>reject(
        new Error('Não foi possível ler o PDF '+file.name+'.')
      );

      reader.onload=()=>{
        const value=String(reader.result||'');
        const comma=value.indexOf(',');
        resolve(comma>=0?value.slice(comma+1):value);
      };

      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  }

  async function uploadFiles_(taskId,files){
    const list=Array.from(files||[]);

    for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      const file=list[i];
      status(
        'Anexando PDF '+(i+1)+' de '+list.length+'…'
      );

      await call(
        'tarefaGeralAnexoAdicionar',
        {
          id:taskId,
          nome:file.name,
          mime:'application/pdf',
          base64:await fileBase64_(file)
        },
        true
      );
    }
  }

  async function openPdf_(taskId,attachment){
    return App.openFileViewer(
      ()=>call(
        'tarefaGeralAnexoConteudo',
        {
          id:taskId,
          anexoId:attachment.id
        },
        false,
        {noLoader:true}
      ),
      {
        nome:attachment.nome||'Anexo da tarefa'
      }
    );
  }


  function makeDistRowInteractive_(card,task,onOpen){
    if(typeof onOpen!=='function'){
      return;
    }

    card.tabIndex=0;
    card.setAttribute(
      'role',
      'button'
    );

    card.setAttribute(
      'aria-label',
      'Abrir: '+
      (
        task.titulo||
        task.pessoa||
        'tarefa'
      )
    );

    card.addEventListener(
      'click',
      event=>{
        const target=event.target;

        if(
          target&&
          target.closest&&
          target.closest(
            'button,a,input,select,textarea,label,summary'
          )
        ){
          return;
        }

        onOpen(task);
      }
    );

    card.addEventListener(
      'keydown',
      event=>{
        if(
          event.key==='Enter'||
          event.key===' '
        ){
          event.preventDefault();
          onOpen(task);
        }
      }
    );
  }

  function distMovementBadge_(task){
    return task.novaManifestacao
      ?el(
          'span',
          'NOVA MANIFESTAÇÃO',
          'dist-new-movement'
        )
      :null;
  }

  function assignmentCard_(task,users,refresh,onOpen){
    const card=el(
      'article',
      undefined,
      'dist-task-card '+(
        task.situacao==='PENDENTE_ATRIBUICAO'
          ?'unassigned'
          :'assigned'
      )+
      (task.vencimentoEstado==='VENCIDA'?' overdue':'')+
      (task.vencimentoEstado==='ATE_24H'?' due-24':'')+
      (task.vencimentoEstado==='ATE_96H'?' due-96':'')+
      (task.novaManifestacao?' has-new-movement':'')
    );

    if(task.tags&&task.tags[0]&&task.tags[0].cor){
      card.style.setProperty('--task-accent',task.tags[0].cor);
    }

    const top=el('div',undefined,'dist-task-top');
    const copy=el('div');

    copy.append(
      el('strong',task.pessoa),
      el(
        'small',
        cpf_(task.cpf)+(task.cidade?' · '+task.cidade:'')
      )
    );

    const stateGroup=
      el(
        'span',
        undefined,
        'dist-state-group'
      );

    const movement=
      distMovementBadge_(task);

    if(movement){
      stateGroup.append(movement);
    }

    stateGroup.append(
      el(
        'span',
        task.situacao==='PENDENTE_ATRIBUICAO'
          ?'SEM RESPONSÁVEL'
          :'ATRIBUÍDA',
        'dist-task-status'
      )
    );

    top.append(
      copy,
      stateGroup
    );

    const info=el('div',undefined,'dist-task-info');

    [
      ['Jurisdição',task.jurisdicao||'—'],
      ['Valor da causa',money_(task.valorCausa)],
      [
        'Responsável atual',
        task.responsavelNome||task.responsavel||'Não atribuído'
      ],
      [
        'Distribuída em',
        task.dataDistribuicao
          ?dateTime_(task.dataDistribuicao)
          :'—'
      ],
      [
        'Prazo',
        date_(task.prazo)
      ]
    ].forEach(([label,value])=>{
      const item=el('div');
      item.append(el('span',label),el('strong',value));
      info.append(item);
    });

    const assign=el('div',undefined,'dist-assign-row');
    const select=el('select');

    select.append(
      new Option('Selecione o responsável','')
    );

    users.forEach(user=>{
      const option=new Option(
        [user.nome,user.funcao,user.email].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
        user.email
      );

      if(
        String(task.responsavel||'').toLowerCase()===
        String(user.email||'').toLowerCase()
      ){
        option.selected=true;
      }

      select.append(option);
    });

    const save=button(
      task.responsavel?'Reatribuir tarefa':'Atribuir tarefa',
      async()=>{
        if(!select.value){
          throw new Error(
            'Selecione um usuário responsável pela distribuição.'
          );
        }

        const result=await call(
          'tarefaDistribuicaoAtribuir',
          {id:task.id,responsavel:select.value},
          true
        );

        const selectedUser=users.find(user=>
          String(user.email||'').toLowerCase()===
          String(result.responsavel||'').toLowerCase()
        );

        task.versao=result.versao||task.versao;
        task.responsavel=result.responsavel||select.value;
        task.responsavelNome=
          selectedUser
            ?selectedUser.nome||selectedUser.email
            :task.responsavel;
        task.situacao=result.situacao||'ATRIBUIDA';
        task.dataDistribuicao=result.atribuidaEm||new Date().toISOString();
        task.modoDistribuicao=result.modoDistribuicao||'MANUAL';

        status('Tarefa atribuída a '+task.responsavelNome+'.');

        /*
         * Atualiza somente o estado já carregado no navegador. Não há nova
         * consulta de toda a fila ao servidor.
         */
        if(typeof refresh==='function'){
          await Promise.resolve(refresh(task));
        }
      }
    );

    assign.append(
      field_('Atribuir distribuição para',select),
      save
    );

    const tags=el('div',undefined,'dist-task-tags');

    (task.tags||[]).forEach(tag=>{
      const chip=el('span',tag.nome||tag,'dist-task-tag');
      if(tag.cor)chip.style.setProperty('--task-tag-color',tag.cor);
      tags.append(chip);
    });

    const quickActions=el('div',undefined,'actions dist-card-quick-actions');

    if(task.pessoaId){
      quickActions.append(
        button(
          'Ver cadastro',
          ()=>App.openPersonDrawer(task.pessoaId),
          true
        )
      );
    }

    card.append(top,info,tags,assign,quickActions);
    makeDistRowInteractive_(
      card,
      task,
      onOpen
    );
    return card;
  }

  function generalCard_(task,onOpen){
    const done=task.situacao==='CONCLUIDA';

      'article',
      undefined,
      'dist-general-card'+
      (done?' done':'')+

    );

    const filters={
      busca:'',
      responsavel:'',
      tipo:'',
      atribuidaDe:'',
      atribuidaAte:'',
      prazoDe:'',
      prazoAte:''
    };

    try{
      Object.assign(
        filters,
        JSON.parse(
          sessionStorage.getItem(FILTER_KEY)||
          '{}'
        )
      );
    }catch(e){}

    const saveFilters_=()=>{
      try{
        sessionStorage.setItem(
          FILTER_KEY,
          JSON.stringify(filters)
        );
      }catch(e){}
    };

      const user=App.state.boot&&App.state.boot.usuario||{};
      const funcao=String(user.funcao||'').toLowerCase();
      return user.perfil==='ADMIN'||funcao==='professor'||funcao==='residente';
    };

    const matches_=task=>{
      if(filters.tipo&&task.tipo!==filters.tipo)return false;
      if(filters.responsavel&&String(task.responsavel||'').toLowerCase()!==filters.responsavel)return false;

      const assigned=String(task.dataDistribuicao||task.atribuidaEm||task.criadoEm||'').slice(0,10);
      if(filters.atribuidaDe&&assigned<filters.atribuidaDe)return false;
      if(filters.atribuidaAte&&assigned>filters.atribuidaAte)return false;

      const due=String(task.prazo||'');

          .slice()
          .sort((a,b)=>
            Number(a[rankKey]||999)-
            Number(b[rankKey]||999)
          )
          .slice(0,5)
          .forEach(row=>{
            const line=el('div',undefined,'dist-rank-line');
            const pos=el('strong',String(row[rankKey]||'—'),'dist-rank-position');
            const person=el('div');
            person.append(
              el('b',row.nome),
              el('small',row.funcao||'')
            );
            line.append(
              pos,
              person,
              el('span',format(row[key]))
            );
            board.append(line);
          });

        return board;
      };

      leaderboards.append(
        board_('Cadastros realizados','cadastros','rankCadastros'),
        board_('Tarefas concluídas','tarefasConcluidas','rankTarefas'),
        board_('Processos distribuídos','processosDistribuidos','rankProcessos'),
        board_(
          'Média processos / login',
          'mediaProcessosPorLogin',
          'rankMedia',
          value=>Number(value||0).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{
            minimumFractionDigits:2,
            maximumFractionDigits:2
          })
        )
      );

      content.append(leaderboards);

      const tableWrap=el('div',undefined,'scroll dist-ranking-table');
      const table=el('table');
      const thead=el('thead');
      const tr=el('tr');

      [
        'Pessoa','Função',
        'Cadastros','Pos. cad.',
        'Tarefas','Pos. tar.',
        'Processos','Pos. proc.',
        'Logins','Proc./login','Pos. média'
      ].forEach(label=>tr.append(el('th',label)));

      thead.append(tr);
      const tbody=el('tbody');

      rows.forEach(row=>{
        const line=el('tr');
        [
          row.nome,
          row.funcao||'—',
          String(row.cadastros),
          String(row.rankCadastros),
          String(row.tarefasConcluidas),
          String(row.rankTarefas),
          String(row.processosDistribuidos),
          String(row.rankProcessos),
          String(row.logins),
          Number(row.mediaProcessosPorLogin||0).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{
            minimumFractionDigits:2,
            maximumFractionDigits:2
          }),
          String(row.rankMedia)
        ].forEach(value=>line.append(el('td',value)));
        tbody.append(line);
      });

      table.append(thead,tbody);
      tableWrap.append(table);
      content.append(tableWrap);
      content.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    };

    const renderOpen_=async()=>{
      mode='open';
      content.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');
      openData=await call('tarefasAbertasGestao',{});
      if(!alive(ctx))return;
      paintOpen_(openData);
    };

    content.replaceChildren(
      baseHead_('Distribuição e tarefas'),
      el(
        'div',
        undefined,
        'dist-instant-list'
      )
    );

    await renderOpen_();
  };
})();
</script>
